title: FERPA — parent inspecting the disclosure record
query: I'm a parent — what disclosures of my kid's records have been made this year?

consultation.query: I'm a parent — what disclosures of my kid's records have been made this year?

decision.query: I'm a parent — what disclosures of my kid's records have been made this year?
decision.llm_response:
Allowed under 34 CFR § 99.32(c)(1).
Parents and eligible students may inspect the record of disclosures the agency is required to maintain under § 99.32(a)(1).

advisor_reply: You can request a record of disclosures for your child's educational records by contacting our Registrar's Office. Under FERPA guidelines, parents have the right to review an accounting of all external record disclosures made in the past year. Please submit a formal written request with your student's name and identifying information, and we'll process your disclosure log within 45 days as required by federal regulations.
